## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided audio tour in Palma, Spain. The listing gives its length as 2 hours, over a route of about 5.0 km. It starts at Catedral-Basílica de Santa María de Mallorca, Portal del Mirador, Carrer del Mirador, 1, Palma, Spain. An entry ticket is part of the package; the listing includes: Palma Cathedral Entry Ticket. The tour plays in the WeGoTrip app on your own phone.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Discover Palma Cathedral and the historic heart of the city with your admission ticket and self-guided audio tour. Your journey begins at the magnificent waterfront cathedral, where golden sandstone walls, soaring Gothic windows, and sweeping views of the bay create an unforgettable first impression.
>
> Inside, explore the cathedral’s most remarkable treasures, from the richly sculpted Portal del Mirador to the striking contemporary Chapel of Saint Peter. You'll uncover the stories behind the monument’s centuries-long construction, learn how Antoni Gaudí transformed its interior, and discover which Mallorcan kings are commemorated within its walls.
>
> After you visit the cathedral, you walk through Parc de la Mar, into the quiet garden of the Arab Baths, on to Sant Francesc and its peaceful square, then through Plaça de Cort at the civic heart of Palma. The tour continues to Sa Llotja near the old harbor, passes the fountains and palms of Hort del Rei, and ends at the Royal Palace of La Almudaina.
>
> Along the way, you will trace the city through conquest, faith, trade, and government while moving between open waterfront views and narrow medieval streets.
